places.name: Rock Canyon Park
places.address: 2620 N Rock Canyon Dr, Provo, UT 84604
places.access_note: Park in the main lot at the top of Rock Canyon Dr; the canyon trail starts past the playground.

ideas.title: Sunset walk up Rock Canyon
ideas.description: Walk a mile up the canyon as the walls turn orange, then turn around for city lights on the way down. Easy, free, and quiet enough to actually talk.
ideas.notes: Example only: the pin and hours are rough, check before using.

ideas.title: Blanket fort movie night
ideas.description: Build a fort out of every blanket and pillow in the house, string some lights inside, and watch a movie you both loved as kids.
